stories.snippet:
const SimpleDialog = () => (
  <Dialog open>
    <DialogContent>
      <DialogHeader>
        <DialogTitle>Confirm</DialogTitle>
        <DialogDescription>
          Are you sure you want to proceed with this action?
        </DialogDescription>
      </DialogHeader>
      <DialogFooter>
        <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="destructive">Confirm</Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
);
